leg_fallback_finding.experiment: deploy/p0_gates/leg_fallback_experiment.py, run in-container against the deployed image with a failing embedding double (zero external quota)
leg_fallback_finding.meaning: an embedding failure aborts the route before the store round trip, so lexical search NEVER runs in that route. There is no text-search fallback in the current architecture.
leg_fallback_finding.consequence_for_the_design: the C3 wording ('已自动切换为文本检索模式') asserts a mechanism the contract does not guarantee. The C4 gate on evidence_completeness already prevents showing it: a dense failure yields insufficient evidence, so the user gets the generic notice instead. The friendly wording is therefore effectively dormant and never misleading.
leg_fallback_finding.recommendation: reword C3 to drop the mechanism claim (e.g. 语义检索暂时受限，本次回答可能不完整。) or accept that C3 and C4 collapse into one message. Needs a decision; no code change made pending it.
